title: Garage
description: Garage object storage: capacity, cluster health, S3 API, disk I/O and background work. Inspired by the Deuxfleurs dashboard (script/telemetry).

panels.title: Cluster healthy
panels.description: All storage nodes are connected and all partitions have all replicas.

panels.title: Cluster available
panels.description: Every partition has a write quorum, so the cluster can serve requests.

panels.title: Data volume used
panels.description: Used share of the filesystem backing the Garage data directory.

targets.expr: 1 - sum(garage_local_disk_avail{job="garage", service=~"$cluster", volume="data"}) / sum(garage_local_disk_total{job="garage", service=~"$cluster", volume="data"})

panels.title: Metadata volume used
panels.description: Used share of the filesystem backing the Garage metadata directory.

targets.expr: 1 - sum(garage_local_disk_avail{job="garage", service=~"$cluster", volume="metadata"}) / sum(garage_local_disk_total{job="garage", service=~"$cluster", volume="metadata"})

panels.title: Data free in 30 days (projected)
panels.description: Linear projection of free space on the data volume, based on the last 7 days. Needs a few days of history to be meaningful.

panels.title: Objects
panels.description: Entries in the object table. Approximate: includes deleted objects that are still tombstoned.

panels.title: Buckets
panels.description: Entries in the bucket table (approximate, includes tombstones).

targets.expr: 1 - sum by (volume) (garage_local_disk_avail{job="garage", service=~"$cluster"}) / sum by (volume) (garage_local_disk_total{job="garage", service=~"$cluster"})

panels.title: Objects, blocks & keys
panels.description: Table entry counts; approximate since they include tombstones.

panels.title: S3 errors by endpoint
panels.description: 404 on HeadObject/GetObject is normal for backup tools probing for objects.

panels.title: Block I/O
panels.description: Bytes read from / written to the data directory (written shown negative).

panels.title: Resync queue length
panels.description: Blocks waiting to be checked/copied/deleted. Should drain to 0.

panels.title: Resync errored blocks
panels.description: Blocks that failed to resync. Anything above 0 needs attention (garage block list-errors).

panels.title: Admin API requests
panels.description: Mostly the garage-operator reconciling the cluster.
